label: post-hoc development contract review of existing outputs
sourceGradesVersion: original frozen development grading rules in protocol.json
scope: Only unsupported user-task rejection and equal-period eligibility change; original exact extraction, outcome, numerical, evidence and SQL grades remain unchanged.

rules.equalPeriods: Task/contract mismatch excluded from eligible user-task success denominator; not a model-task failure or a new pass. Original extraction diagnostics preserved.
rules.unsupported: Pass user-task rejection iff the explicit unsupported metric/dimension is correctly identified, unsupported outcome returned, and zero SQL executes. Unrelated date fields do not gate rejection success.
rules.remainingCases: Retain all original task criteria without relaxation.
rules.denominators: Original strict results use all 15 frozen cases. Reviewed user-task results use 14 eligible cases. Exact extraction diagnostics retain all 15.
